entries.name: isis-gacha
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-body adult Egyptian goddess Isis for a colorful modern anime gacha strategy game. Bold unmistakably TWO-DIMENSIONAL ANIME illustration with clean linework, flat cel shading, graphic two-tone shadows, large expressive almond eyes, stylized small nose, confident playful smile, idealized adult athletic proportions. NOT photorealistic, NOT semi-realistic painted skin, NOT 3D render, NO realistic material textures or tiny engraved ornaments. Bronze skin, large flowing indigo hair masses with just two thick gold-banded braids. Recognizable large polished gold crescent-horn crown with black solar disk. Bright ivory short layered tunic and split knee-length skirt panels over fitted royal blue leggings, vivid turquoise detached cape panels, bold simple gold waist armor and collar with ONE large turquoise gem. Sturdy gold sandals, both feet clearly visible and separated. Long clean gold and deep blue ANKH magical staff with turquoise crystal held in left side of image well away from torso. Open empty other hand on right side. Animation-ready relaxed battle stance, three-quarter facing slightly right; hands and weapon clearly separated from body, very simple flowing cloth shapes. White ivory, saturated turquoise and gold dominate. Face highly readable at small size. Entire character including staff centered on a SQUARE transparent canvas, ONLY 60 percent of canvas height, enormous empty transparent margins for wide attack motion. Fully visible head to toe and staff both ends. NO aura, wings, feathers, effects, particles, scenery, ground, drop shadow, text or UI. Truly transparent background. Original design based on mythology, polished premium anime game character.

entries.name: isis-fantasy
entries.prompt: Redesign our original Isis hero from the reference. Reference is identity/mythological symbols ONLY, not its dark realistic rendering or narrow format. ONE full-body adult Egyptian goddess Isis, Lord rank, bronze skin, deep indigo black hair in large clean braids, expressive confident warm face, gold horn-shaped crown enclosing a black solar disk, ivory and vivid turquoise costume with royal blue accents, simplified broad gold waist armor, readable gold collar, split fabric panels ending above feet, both golden sandals visible. Large clean shapes, restrained ornament, brilliant saturated colors, strong light/dark separation, bright face. Gold and dark blue magical ankh staff with turquoise crystal, held upright on viewer LEFT clearly outside torso; free arm slightly extended on viewer RIGHT with empty open palm. Relaxed animation-ready battle stance, separated feet and limbs, torso slight three-quarter towards viewer right, face readable, no extreme foreshortening. No wings, halo, floating feathers, spell or particles baked into figure: those are separate future VFX. SQUARE 1:1 transparent canvas, entire character and staff occupy only central 60% of height and central 50% width, feet around 80% canvas height, very generous clear space on ALL sides for overhead staff swing and turns. Keep complete crown, staff tip and sandals uncut. No scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, text, UI or frame. Genuine transparent alpha. STYLE B: vibrant painterly fantasy illustration. Natural adult proportions and face, visible confident broad painted shapes, selective soft blending and crisp focal edges, bright airy lighting with cool turquoise shadows and warm skin. Colorful illustrated storybook epic fantasy, not photoreal or photographic, not anime, no muddy browns or gritty weathering.
